description: Browser-based file manager for jailbroken PS5 consoles — browse, upload, download, copy, move, rename, and delete files at http://<PS5_IP>:5905/. Built-in archive extraction (ZIP, RAR, 7z).

Stable file-manager-only `bfpilot.elf` for broad firmware compatibility.
Separate `bfpilot-launcher-installer.elf` for the PS5 home-screen tile.

Persistent custom shortcuts with add, remove, and rename controls.
Transfer diagnostics with timing, throughput, byte counts, device IDs, and last-upload stats.
Faster PS5-side copy path with a larger transfer buffer.
Local diagnostics and a safe smoke test for upload, download, copy, move, rename, and cleanup under `/data/test`.
Repository cleanup: old debug/full/probe payloads and generated artifacts were removed from the release surface.
